resources.string: Takes screenshots of the game\'s screen and taps and swipes in it, only while an auto expedition run is going (debug builds also tap for auto nectar). It never reads window content, and screenshots are never saved or sent. Any app can see which accessibility services are on, so turn this off when you do not need it.

From the floating bar, sends Pikmin on fruit and seedling-pot expeditions in one go, or feeds nectar on the feed screen. Needs Android 11 or newer and this app\'s accessibility service turned on. While a run goes, the app reads the game\'s screen and taps and swipes in it. Red gifts and mushrooms are never touched. The game can see that accessibility is on, so use it at your own risk.
